description:
Scheduler::settle_quiescent_fact (scheduler.rs) certifies as settled every fact that is not quiet and whose OWN publisher is clean, whenever the agenda empties. Its comment promises "a locally clean cone holding no dirty fact cannot move, so it is final", but the code inspects the fact, not the cone: the ground walk (has_unsettled_external_ground) runs only when product sessions are attached and returns true only for an unsettled external product; a dirty scheduler publisher beneath does not stop it. The agenda empties at every STALL, because a blocked waiter's missing producer is demanded at the same drain (drive.rs drive_until: settle_quiescent_waits, then demand_fact_producer). So partial accumulations over undiscovered layers are certified one layer at a time. Measured on json_roundtrip at 549c3b05d: 155 drains per compile; certifications later overtaken by a higher revision: CallSiteSummary 545, CallSiteTargets 443, ActivationAnalyzed 111, ReturnType 77; the drains wake DeriveExecutableFacts 143 times. On the fz-kdt.98.2 Reaches tree the same rule certified Reaches(main) 15 times and ran main's component job 110 times.

Repair, measured (session scratchpad drain-cone.patch): (1) the ground walk runs unconditionally and refuses when any publisher in the transitive read ground is dirty or an external product is unsettled; a quiet fact ends the walk, so a clean cycle still certifies at its first drain; (2) certify every unquiet fact the walk visited, not only the asked one, since the same argument proved them all final and leaving them unfinal re-arbitrates each at a later drain and wakes its readers again. Result: 00181 job starts 443 -> 433, json_roundtrip 4527 -> 4371 (DeriveExecutableFacts 368 -> 225, drain events 155 -> 2), program output identical. Tests: the existing compiler2_scheduler_the_drain_arbiter_refuses_a_fact_whose_own_publisher_is_dirty pinned the defect as green (asserted c settled over dirty a, "nothing can move without waking them first"); flipped with a settled waiter and renamed ..._refuses_a_fact_over_a_dirty_publisher, RED at HEAD; an_unrelated_dirty_product_does_not_block_fact_quiescence and quiescent_read_accounting_distinguishes_old_ground_from_new_unquiet_edges rebuilt on a clean two-publisher cycle because their setups smuggled a dirty publisher. Scheduler suite 51/51 with the patch. Delete ExternalDependencyStates::has_unsettled_dependencies (pull.rs, scheduler.rs) with the gate. Verify the public_trace_test pin runtime_demand_evaluations 155 -> 5 in the edit scenario is real recomputation, not a skipped edit, before re-pinning; pins may only move down. Docs: fact-engine.md drain section must state the cone rule. Blocked by fz-kdt.228 (derivation identity): under the strict rule 11 nested-macro-root tests stall until a blocked scope walk can conclude the claims it does not depend on.

title: The quiescence drain certifies a fact over dirty ground, one fact at a time
